comparison.method: Download without authentication; compare every archive file body with the complete tracked-file inventory at the tag commit. Directory entries and ZIP container metadata are excluded.

scope: The archive contains raw-archive indexes and hashes, not the external raw bytes. This verifies software-snapshot identity, not new scientific results. The immutable tag CFF uses the software concept DOI; subsequent branch metadata records the minted version DOI.
